instruction: My brother asked me to buy something for them from amazon. But I totally forgot to place the order. They sent me the money for it on venmo. Place the necessary amazon order for my home address and add a "Thanks a lot!" comment on their venmo payment.
notes: Brother is found via phone.search_contacts (relationship sibling); his email filters venmo.show_transactions to find the received payment whose description names the product and gives the transaction id. The product name becomes the amazon.search_products query; the product is added to the cart with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true so the order contains exactly one item of quantity 1. supervisor.show_addresses reveals the home address text; amazon.show_addresses yields the matching address id (if absent, amazon.add_address would be needed; the evaluation tolerates added addresses). amazon.show_payment_cards supplies a card id for place_order. A comment is then posted on the brother's venmo transaction. supervisor.complete_task takes no API arguments (no question asked); its non-API parameters pin the order, product, home address, transaction and comment so its precondition equals the goal. Static init facts encode entity structure only; all ids are discovered at runtime.
